summary: Verificare statica + pytest pentru pachetul Windows build (workflow GitHub Actions, PyInstaller spec, Inno Setup script, build_exe.bat) si regresie MAIN<->server sync pe Linux. Toate testele trec: desktop/tests/test_build_packaging.py 25/25, backend sync (etapa2+3+4) 36/36, desktop suite 206 passed + 2 skipped (env-only pyzbar). Workflow .github/workflows/build-windows.yml este corect configurat: job-level env `WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64` face conditia `if: env.WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64 != ''` sa functioneze corect pe step; cache-dependency-path pointeaza la desktop/requirements.txt (hash OK); linia `emergentintegrations @ git+https://...` este filtrata inainte de pip install printr-un pipe PowerShell Where-Object; upload-artifact paths sunt relative la GITHUB_WORKSPACE (desktop/dist_installer/CimitirSetup-*.exe si desktop/dist/Cimitir-portabil.exe) ceea ce corespunde output-ului ISCC (OutputDir=..\dist_installer relativ la installer/cimitir_setup.iss) si al Move-Item pentru varianta portabila; versiune citita cu Select-String corect. cimitir.spec se evalueaza fara erori pentru toate cele 4 combo-uri (ONEFILE 0/1 x SLIM 0/1); hiddenimports contine acum cimitir_requests + celelalte module shared (cimitir_database, cimitir_config, cimitir_auth, cimitir_public, cloud_sync, cloud_sync_auto, cloud_sync_window, access_session, main, web_server). build_exe.bat are CRLF (test_crlf_line_endings trece); toate etichetele :call sunt definite. installer/cimitir_setup.iss contine toate sectiunile necesare, referintele ..\icon.ico si ..\LICENSE.txt exista. Nu am modificat niciun fisier.
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow build-windows.yml linia 15-16: `env: WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64` ridicat la nivel de job -> `if: ${{ env.WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64 != '' }}` pe step functioneaza (fix corect, step-level env nu e vizibil in propriul if).
Workflow linia 28: `cache-dependency-path: desktop/requirements.txt` corect pentru cache:pip (requirements.txt exista la aceasta cale, cache hash stabil).

Workflow linia 33: filtrul `Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^emergentintegrations' }` elimina corect dependinta git+https care nu e instalabila pe CI; se mentine conform spec-ului care are deja emergentintegrations in excludes.
Workflow linia 55: Move-Item folosest slash forward in PowerShell, functioneaza; `dist/` exista deja (creat de pasul folder) deci move-ul nu esueaza.
Workflow linia 63: `${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}` cu paranteze este sintaxa PowerShell valida (${env:...} gestioneaza parantezele).

Workflow linia 69: ISCC ruleaza cu working-directory=desktop; `installer\cimitir_setup.iss` + OutputDir `..\dist_installer` (relativ la .iss) rezolva la desktop/dist_installer/ — se potriveste cu upload-artifact path.
Workflow linia 75,81: upload-artifact `path` este relativ la GITHUB_WORKSPACE (nu la working-directory), de aceea `desktop/dist_installer/...` si `desktop/dist/...` sunt corecte.
cimitir.spec linia 86-90: adaugate cimitir_requests + modulele shared in hiddenimports — necesar pentru import dinamic prin desktop/database.py.

Observatie minora (nu blocanta): daca user-ul uita sa configureze `secrets.WINDOWS_CERT_BASE64`, pasul de semnare este skipped silentios — corect pentru build-uri comunitare, dar un `echo '[INFO] fara semnare digitala'` in else ar imbunatati feedback-ul in logul CI.
